plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
deployment: Deployed with `sudo ovhost deploy events`: /opt/openvibe.events, unit openvibe-events, 127.0.0.1:4300; public at https://events.openvibe.network (realtime SSE, health, token-guarded /api/v1/events, /api/v1/subscriptions, /api/v1/checkpoints; /api/v1/deliveries host-local); real traffic since 2026-09-23 (Live, Media, Chat, Games, Network and OpenRe publish; on 2026-09-23 8 subscriptions, held by Search, Tips, VIP, News and Reviews); restore drill passed 2026-09-23
features: durable event store with the canonical envelope
subscriptions with signed webhook delivery (v1 and v2), retry, dead letters and replay
pull consumers with cursors and checkpoints
realtime SSE with cursor resume, gap reports and Network tickets
developer-app publish, read and subscribe with sandbox separation, SSRF-guarded webhooks and project quotas

carrier fabric (ADR-042): the pg-v1 poll beside a valkey-v1 push carrier for QUEUE (streams) and TOPIC (SSE fan-out) an optional nats-v1 NATS Core TOPIC carrier (NATS_URL) and an optional nats-js-v1 JetStream STREAM carrier (NATS_URL, NATS_JETSTREAM; deploy/nats), with a placement planner, per-key pinning, delivery_placements history and a GET /api/v1/placement explain API; EVENTS_CARRIERS[_DISABLED] switches it
at_most_once delivery semantics (a failed attempt is final)
